entries.text:
Several months had passed since Break the World brought the Multiverse into being. In this new world, where chaos and order coexisted, clashes between nations and organizations had gradually grown fiercer.

The New Earth Federation was the largest political entity in the Multiverse. Using its immense power, it absorbed nations one after another in the name of uniting humanity's will and maintaining order. At the same time, it became mired in internal power struggles.

Amid these competing agendas, New Earth Federation military headquarters issued a special order. A new unit was to be formed.

entries.text:
Task Force 013, formed to fulfill someone's designs, was disbanded when its mission was complete.

BG's true identity, the masked figure's purpose, the existence of the mysterious giant weapon that figure piloted...

With so many questions unanswered, the members returned to battle, each with their own purpose in mind.

Their paths would cross again in many ways. Sometimes as allies, sometimes as enemies...

Unaware of where fate would lead them, they kept fighting, staking their lives on what they believed in.

Year 1 of the Multiversal Century... The world's chaos and war continue.

entries.text:
Year 1 of the Multiversal Century.

With faction leaders dying in battle and organizations falling apart, the vast conflict that had engulfed the entire Multiverse born from Break the World was beginning to subside.

A new day had dawned at the UN Station after the truth was made public. As the hour for repairing space-time approached, the members of ZEUTH, the independent mobile force, looked back on their memories of all the battles they had fought.

Encounters, clashes, farewells...

What had these memories, colored by war, given them and people around the world? What had they left behind...?

entries.text:
Break the World had created more than memories of sorrow and pain. The birth of the Multiverse had brought countless encounters along with the fighting. In those encounters were the joy of living, trust and hope.

Repairing space-time meant safeguarding these things. That was both ZEUTH's mission and its wish.

There was little time left before the deadline. For the future of the world they cherished, they renewed their resolve for the final battle.

entries.text:
September 16, Multiversal Century 0001

ZEUTH has left Tampagunda Base and is heading for ZAFT's Gibraltar Base.

As the world's chaos accelerates, I sometimes find myself wondering what ZEUTH can do, and what I can do as a part of it.

The transformed Ganary Carver's combat potential is still unknown, but I have made up my mind to draw out its hidden power.

But am I worthy of bearing the name Glory Star...?

That question leaves me doubting myself again today.

GloryStar 3rd.

entries.text:
September 29, Multiversal Century 0001

ZEUTH will soon arrive at ZAFT's Gibraltar Base.

The question from a few days ago still lingers within me. So I mean to live in a way that lets me answer it with pride.

To me, living means carrying on Glory Star's pride. I want to believe that, as long as I hold on to that conviction, sorrow will never defeat me.

The fighting will continue, and I will probably face Asakim Dowen again someday. But I will keep fighting, with my pride and my mission in my heart.

GloryStar 3rd.

entries.text:
October 22, Multiversal Century 0001

Since the New Earth Federation coup, it's been one surprise after another. Even we're worn out!

We fought the other ZEUTH group over a misunderstanding, then came that shocking revelation about Eureka!

Drained by all these surprises, we're resting at a place called Tresor Institute. But I can't shake the feeling that something's about to happen.

More material for my Memory Notebook is great, but what's next for us and this world...?

But hey, there's no point in me worrying!

Acting President, Mel Beater

entries.text:
November 8, Multiversal Century 0001

A lot's happened, but Darling and I were full of energy again today.

Looks like our stay at Tresor Institute is almost over. But once we're out of here, it feels like we'll get dragged into even fiercer fighting...

But this is no time to let it get me down!

With a world this crazy, we have to fire ourselves up and keep giving it our best!

Add my sales smile to Darling's Heat Smile, and we're full of energy today and tomorrow!

Well, good night~.

Acting President, Mel Beater

entries.text:
The repair of space-time stabilized the dimensional boundaries, and the Multiverse escaped the threat of collapse.

Of course, not all the turmoil had been resolved. The First Multiversal War, which had engulfed the world in flames, had left deep scars on nations and in people's hearts.

Even so, their faces were bright. The arrival of the peaceful days they had long awaited was a great joy, and everyone believed that this hope would create a new era.

But sorrow and pain were not over. In the shadow of people's hopes, a threat unknown to anyone was about to awaken.

entries.text:
No way remains to learn the true purpose of the Executor, a ghost of the Black History.

Did earlier generations, who lived through space-time's destruction, think Earth had no need for humanity?

Perhaps the answer is for those alive today to decide. If humanity is foolish, it is doomed to perish with this planet...

Yet the world goes on, carrying the hopes of those who fought believing in the future.

Today, as Year 1 of the Multiversal Century nears its end, the world keeps changing.

From Chapter 1 of "Chronicle of the Changing Multiverse"
